lines.en: Today's, uh, Mike and my one-year anniversary.
Your first, uh, date? Your first kiss?
-So, you must be going somewhere fancy to celebrate.
-Hey, you know what? I've never had a one-year anniversary before,
so no matter where we go, I'm wearing something fancy pants
and I'm gonna put on my finest jewelry
and we're gonna have sex in a public restroom.
Chandler won't even have sex in our bathroom.
